title: Eastern Canada Premium Fitness Pass
includes: Max savings up to 50% on regular price.
Not valid for people under 18 years of age (not included)
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Not suitable for under those aged under 18 years
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Are you an avid gym-goer who wants to maintain your fitness routine while traveling? Look no further than the Premium Fitness Pass - Eastern Canada!

With this pass, you can access the top gyms across the city with no time restrictions, so you can work out at your convenience. Whether you're an early bird or a night owl, this pass will put your fitness needs first. Plus, with free cancellation up to 2 hours before class, you can enjoy peace of mind and flexibility in your schedule. This pass comes in 1, 2, or 5-entry options, each valid for up to 1 year from the date of purchase. No need to commit to membership fees - with the Premium Fitness Pass, you have the freedom to choose what works best for you so you can stay active and healthy while exploring the city.

Whether you're here for a short visit or a longer stay, this pass has got you covered. Don't forget to pack your workout clothes and grab your Premium Fitness Pass - it's time to hit the gym!
